author: ReyCassie
body:
Dear Avicus staff,
 I am writing my second appeal after my first one being denied for lack of time put into the appeal itself. This appeal ls for the perm ban of my alt account because I was “ban evading”. I accidentally while going to select a server clicked Avicus’ server out of habit and connected to the server for no more than 5 seconds before realizing what I had clicked and logging back out. I had no intention of playing any of the game modes and I’d like to stress that fact that it was an honest mistake. I also would like to mention that I was banned later that day not while I was logged in for 5 seconds which I would’ve liked the chance before getting banned to have received a warning or at least got a chance to explain what had happened with a staff member prior to the ban.  It’s difficult for staff to not jump to conclusions about me due to the events in the past few days but I would still appreciate the opportunity to let you hear my case and consider it more in depth because after all we are human and we all make this simple and little mistakes. 
I look forward to your reply
KN10

title: My appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello Nemo, 

I find it hard to believe that you accidentally logged in. After all, you know the rules. Regarding the ban being later, that is because you can be banned for ban evasion at any given time, without a warning. After all, you're avoiding a ban. I am sorry, but this ban will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax,
Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
